sentences.en: I'm going to tell you a little bit about my TEDxHouston Talk.
sentences.zh: 我要告诉你一点 关于我的TEDxHouston演讲。

sentences.en: I woke up the morning after I gave that talk with the worst vulnerability hangover of my life.
sentences.zh: 早上我醒来 之后,我说了 与我生命中最脆弱的宿醉。

sentences.en: And I actually didn't leave my house for about three days.
sentences.zh: 事实上我三天没离开我家了

sentences.en: The first time I left was to meet a friend for lunch.
sentences.zh: 我第一次离开是去见一个朋友吃午饭

sentences.en: And when I walked in, she was already at the table.
sentences.zh: 当我走进来的时候,她已经在桌子上。

sentences.en: I sat down, and she said, "God, you look like hell."
sentences.zh: 我坐下,她说, "上帝,你看起来像地狱。"

sentences.en: I said, "Thanks. I feel really -- I'm not functioning."
sentences.zh: 我说,"谢谢,我觉得我真的不起作用"

sentences.en: And she said, "What's going on?" And I said, "I just told 500 people that I became a researcher to avoid vulnerability.
sentences.zh: 她说,“发生什么事了?” 我说,“我刚刚告诉500人,我成为一名研究人员是为了避免脆弱性。

sentences.en: And that when being vulnerable emerged from my data, as absolutely essential to whole-hearted living, I told these 500 people that I had a breakdown.
sentences.zh: 当脆弱的出现 从我的数据, 作为绝对 至关重要的全心全意的生活, 我告诉这500人,我有一个崩溃。

sentences.en: I had a slide that said 'Breakdown.' At what point did I think that was a good idea?"
sentences.zh: 我有一张幻灯片上写着"裂开" 我什么时候觉得这是个好主意?

sentences.en: (Laughter) And she said, "I saw your talk live-streamed.
sentences.zh: 她说:"我看到你的演讲是直播的"

sentences.en: It was not really you. It was a little different than what you usually do.
sentences.zh: 跟你平常做的有点不同

sentences.en: But it was great." And I said, "This can't happen.
sentences.zh: 但它是伟大的。" 我说,"这不可能发生。

sentences.en: YouTube, they're putting this thing on YouTube.
sentences.zh: YouTube 他们把这东西放到YouTube上

sentences.en: And we're going to be talking about 600, 700 people."
sentences.zh: 我们将要谈论600,700人。"

sentences.en: (Laughter) And she said, "Well, I think it's too late."
sentences.zh: (笑声) 她说,"嗯,我想这是太晚了。"

sentences.en: And I said, "Let me ask you something." And she said, "Yeah."
sentences.zh: 我说,"让我问你一件事。" 她说,"是的。"

sentences.en: I said, "Do you remember when we were in college, really wild and kind of dumb?"
sentences.zh: 我说,"你还记得我们大学的时候, 真的很野,有点笨吗?"

sentences.en: She said, "Yeah." I said, "Remember when we'd leave a really bad message on our ex-boyfriend's answering machine?
sentences.zh: 她说,"是的。" 我说,"还记得当我们 留下一个非常糟糕的消息 在我们的前男友的答录机?

sentences.en: Then we'd have to break into his dorm room and then erase the tape?"
sentences.zh: 然后我们得闯进他的宿舍 然后删掉磁带?"

sentences.en: (Laughter) And she goes, "Uh... no." (Laughter) Of course, the only thing I could say at that point was, "Yeah, me neither.
sentences.zh: 她说,"嗯... 不" 当然,当时我唯一能说的就是,"是啊,我也没有"

sentences.en: Yeah -- me neither." And I'm thinking to myself, "Brené, what are you doing?
sentences.zh: 是啊,我也没有。”我对自己说,“布伦内,你在做什么?

sentences.en: Why did you bring this up? Have you lost your mind?
sentences.zh: 你为什么要提起这件事?

sentences.en: Your sisters would be perfect for this."
sentences.zh: 你的姐妹会是完美的。"

sentences.en: (Laughter) So I looked back up and she said, "Are you really going to try to break in and steal the video before they put it on YouTube?"
sentences.zh: (笑声) 于是我回过头来,她说, “你真的想在视频被放上YouTube之前 破门而入吗?”

sentences.en: (Laughter) And I said, "I'm just thinking about it a little bit."
sentences.zh: 我说:"我只是在考虑一下"

sentences.en: (Laughter) She said, "You're like the worst vulnerability role model ever."
sentences.zh: 她说 "你是最差的脆弱榜样"

sentences.en: (Laughter) Then I looked at her and I said something that at the time felt a little dramatic, but ended up being more prophetic than dramatic.
sentences.zh: 然后我看着她,我说了一些话 当时感觉有点戏剧性, 但最后却比戏剧性更具有预言性。

sentences.en: "If 500 turns into 1,000 or 2,000, my life is over."
sentences.zh: "如果500变成1000或2,000,我的生活就结束了"

sentences.en: (Laughter) I had no contingency plan for four million.
sentences.zh: 我没有四百万的应急计划

sentences.en: (Laughter) And my life did end when that happened.
sentences.zh: (笑声) 我的生命确实结束了 当事情发生。

sentences.en: And maybe the hardest part about my life ending is that I learned something hard about myself, and that was that, as much as I would be frustrated
sentences.zh: 也许人生最艰难的结局是 我对自己学到了一些艰难的东西, 就是这样,因为我会很沮丧

sentences.en: about not being able to get my work out to the world, there was a part of me that was working very hard to engineer staying small, staying right under the radar.
sentences.zh: 关于无法将我的工作 带到世界, 有一部分我 工作非常努力的工程 保持小, 保持在雷达下。

sentences.en: But I want to talk about what I've learned.
sentences.zh: 但我想谈谈我学到了什么

sentences.en: There's two things that I've learned in the last year.
sentences.zh: 去年我学到了两件事

sentences.en: The first is: vulnerability is not weakness.
sentences.zh: 第一是:脆弱性不是弱点。

sentences.en: And that myth is profoundly dangerous. Let me ask you honestly -- and I'll give you this warning, I'm trained as a therapist, so I can out-wait you uncomfortably --
sentences.zh: 这个神话非常危险。我诚实地问你—— 我会警告你,我受过心理治疗师的训练, 这样我就可以不适地等待你——

sentences.en: so if you could just raise your hand that would be awesome -- how many of you honestly, when you're thinking about doing or saying something vulnerable think, "God, vulnerability is weakness."
sentences.zh: 所以如果你能举起你的手 那将是真棒 - 有多少人说实话, 当你想做或说一些脆弱的东西 认为,“上帝,脆弱就是弱点。”

sentences.en: How many of you think of vulnerability and weakness synonymously?
sentences.zh: 你们中有多少人认为脆弱和弱点是同义词?

sentences.en: The majority of people. Now let me ask you this question: This past week at TED, how many of you, when you saw vulnerability up here, thought it was pure courage?
sentences.zh: 大多数人。现在让我来问你这个问题: 在过去的一周,在TED, 有多少人,当你在这里看到脆弱的时候, 认为这是纯粹的勇气?

sentences.en: Vulnerability is not weakness. I define vulnerability as emotional risk, exposure, uncertainty.
sentences.zh: 脆弱性不是弱点,我把脆弱性定义为情感风险、暴露、不确定性。

sentences.en: It fuels our daily lives. And I've come to the belief -- this is my 12th year doing this research -- that vulnerability is our most accurate measurement of courage --
sentences.zh: 它丰富了我们的日常生活。我开始相信——这是我进行这项研究的第12年—— 脆弱性是我们最准确地衡量勇气的尺度——

sentences.en: to be vulnerable, to let ourselves be seen, to be honest.
sentences.zh: 成为脆弱的, 让自己被看到, 说实话。

sentences.en: One of the weird things that's happened is, after the TED explosion, I got a lot of offers to speak all over the country -- everyone from schools and parent meetings to Fortune 500 companies.
sentences.zh: 在TED爆炸之后, 发生了一件奇怪的事情, 我得到了很多的报价, 从学校和家长会议到“财富”500家公司。

sentences.en: And so many of the calls went like this, "Dr. Brown, we loved your TED talk.
sentences.zh: 如此多的电话是这样的, “布朗博士,我们很喜欢你的TED演讲。

sentences.en: We'd like you to come in and speak. We'd appreciate it if you wouldn't mention vulnerability or shame."
sentences.zh: 我们希望你能进来谈谈 如果你不提脆弱或羞耻的话

sentences.en: (Laughter) What would you like for me to talk about?
sentences.zh: 你想让我谈什么?

sentences.en: There's three big answers. This is mostly, to be honest with you, from the business sector: innovation, creativity and change.
sentences.zh: 有三个大答案。这主要来自商业部门:创新、创造力和变革。

sentences.en: (Laughter) So let me go on the record and say, vulnerability is the birthplace of innovation, creativity and change.
sentences.zh: (笑)所以让我记录下来说, 脆弱性是创新、创造力和变化的发源地。

sentences.en: (Applause) To create is to make something that has never existed before.
sentences.zh: (掌声) 创造就是创造 从未存在的东西。

sentences.en: There's nothing more vulnerable than that.
sentences.zh: 没有什么比这更脆弱了

sentences.en: Adaptability to change is all about vulnerability.
sentences.zh: 适应变化的能力完全在于脆弱性。

sentences.en: The second thing, in addition to really finally understanding the relationship between vulnerability and courage, the second thing I learned, is this: We have to talk about shame.
sentences.zh: 第二件事,除了真正终于理解了 脆弱性和勇气之间的关系之外, 我学到的第二件事是: 我们必须谈论羞耻。

sentences.en: And I'm going to be really honest with you.
sentences.zh: 我会对你说实话的

sentences.en: When I became a "vulnerability researcher" and that became the focus because of the TED talk -- and I'm not kidding.
sentences.zh: 当我成为“脆弱性研究者”的时候,由于TED的演讲,这成了焦点——我不是开玩笑的。

sentences.en: I'll give you an example. About three months ago, I was in a sporting goods store buying goggles and shin guards and all the things that parents buy at the sporting goods store.
sentences.zh: 我举个例子 大约三个月前 我在体育用品店买护目镜

sentences.en: About from a hundred feet away, this is what I hear: "Vulnerability TED! Vulnerability TED!"
sentences.zh: 大约在100英尺外,我听到的是: "脆弱性TED!脆弱性TED!"

sentences.en: (Laughter) (Laughter ends) I'm a fifth-generation Texan.
sentences.zh: 我是第五代德克萨斯人

sentences.en: Our family motto is "Lock and load." I am not a natural vulnerability researcher.
sentences.zh: 我们家族的座右铭是"口交" 我不是天生的脆弱研究者

sentences.en: So I'm like, just keep walking, she's on my six.
sentences.zh: 所以我想,只是继续走, 她在我的6。

sentences.en: (Laughter) And then I hear, "Vulnerability TED!"
sentences.zh: 然后,我听到,"脆弱性TED!"

sentences.en: I turn around, I go, "Hi." She's right here and she said, "You're the shame researcher who had the breakdown."
sentences.zh: 我转过身,我走了,"嗨。" 她就在这里,她说,"你是耻辱的 研究谁崩溃。"

sentences.en: (Laughter) At this point, parents are, like, pulling their children close.
sentences.zh: (笑声) 此时此刻, 父母一样,拉近他们的孩子。

sentences.en: (Laughter) "Look away." And I'm so worn out at this point in my life, I look at her and I actually say, "It was a fricking spiritual awakening."
sentences.zh: (笑声) "看远了。"我是如此疲惫 在我生命的这一刻, 我看着她,我实际上说,"这是一个令人发指的精神觉醒。"

sentences.en: (Laughter) (Applause) And she looks back and does this, "I know."
sentences.zh: (笑) (掌声) 她回过头来做这个, "我知道。"

sentences.en: (Laughter) And she said, "We watched your TED talk in my book club.
sentences.zh: 她说:“我们在我的书社里看过你的TED演讲。

sentences.en: Then we read your book and we renamed ourselves 'The Breakdown Babes.'"
sentences.zh: 然后我们读了你的书 然后我们改名为"崩溃婴儿"

sentences.en: (Laughter) And she said, "Our tagline is: 'We're falling apart and it feels fantastic.'"
sentences.zh: 她说,"我们的标签是:"我们分崩离析,感觉棒极了"

sentences.en: (Laughter) You can only imagine what it's like for me in a faculty meeting.
sentences.zh: (笑)你只能想象 对我来说是什么样子 在一个教师会议。

sentences.en: (Sighs) So when I became Vulnerability TED, like an action figure -- Like Ninja Barbie, but I'm Vulnerability TED -- I thought, I'm going to leave that shame stuff behind,
sentences.zh: (叹气) 当我成为脆弱性TED,就像一个动作人物—— 就像忍者芭比一样, 但我是脆弱性TED——我想,我会把那些羞耻的东西留在后面,

sentences.en: because I spent six years studying shame before I started writing and talking about vulnerability.
sentences.zh: 因为我花了六年时间学习羞耻 在我开始写作和谈论脆弱之前

sentences.en: And I thought, thank God, because shame is this horrible topic, no one wants to talk about it.
sentences.zh: 我想,感谢上帝, 因为羞耻是这个可怕的话题, 没有人想谈论它。

sentences.en: It's the best way to shut people down on an airplane.
sentences.zh: 这是在飞机上关闭人的最好办法

sentences.en: "What do you do?" "I study shame." "Oh."
sentences.zh: "你做什么?" "我学习羞耻" "哦"

sentences.en: (Laughter) And I see you. (Laughter) But in surviving this last year,
sentences.zh: (笑声) 我看到你了。

sentences.en: I was reminded of a cardinal rule -- not a research rule, but a moral imperative from my upbringing -- "you've got to dance with the one who brung ya".
sentences.zh: 我被提醒了一条基本规则—— 不是研究规则, 而是我成长过程中的道德义务—— “你必须和那个 拥抱你的人跳舞。”

sentences.en: And I did not learn about vulnerability and courage and creativity and innovation from studying vulnerability.
sentences.zh: 我没有从研究脆弱性中学会脆弱性和勇气 以及创造力和创新。

sentences.en: I learned about these things from studying shame.
sentences.zh: 我从学习羞耻中学到这些

sentences.en: And so I want to walk you in to shame. Jungian analysts call shame the swampland of the soul.
sentences.zh: 所以我想带你走进去 让你感到羞耻。 Jungian分析家称这为羞耻 沼泽地的灵魂。

sentences.en: And we're going to walk in. And the purpose is not to walk in and construct a home and live there.
sentences.zh: 我们要走进去 目的不是走进去建房子住在那里

sentences.en: It is to put on some galoshes -- and walk through and find our way around.
sentences.zh: 它会穿一些套鞋-- 穿过去,找到我们的路。

sentences.en: Here's why. We heard the most compelling call ever to have a conversation in this country, and I think globally, around race, right?
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么。我们听到最有说服力的号召 在这个国家里有一个对话, 我认为全球, 围绕种族,对不对?

sentences.en: Yes? We heard that. Yes? Cannot have that conversation without shame.
sentences.zh: 是的,我们听到了,不能无耻地交谈

sentences.en: Because you cannot talk about race without talking about privilege.
sentences.zh: 因为你不能谈论种族 不谈论特权。

sentences.en: And when people start talking about privilege, they get paralyzed by shame.
sentences.zh: 当人们开始谈论特权, 他们因为羞耻而瘫痪。

sentences.en: We heard a brilliant simple solution to not killing people in surgery, which is, have a checklist.
sentences.zh: 我们听到一个绝妙的简单解决方案 避免在手术中杀人, 也就是说,有一个核对表。

sentences.en: You can't fix that problem without addressing shame, because when they teach those folks how to suture, they also teach them how to stitch their self-worth to being all-powerful.
sentences.zh: 你不能不解决羞耻的问题, 因为当他们教他们如何缝合的时候, 他们也教他们如何缝合自己的自我价值, 让他们变得无所不能。

sentences.en: And all-powerful folks don't need checklists.
sentences.zh: 全能的人们不需要核对表

sentences.en: And I had to write down the name of this TED Fellow so I didn't mess it up here.
sentences.zh: 我不得不写下这个TED研究员的名字 所以我没有弄乱它在这里。

sentences.en: Myshkin Ingawale, I hope I did right by you.
sentences.zh: Myshkin Ingawale,我希望我做对了你。

sentences.en: (Applause) I saw the TED Fellows my first day here.
sentences.zh: (掌声) 我在这里看到TED的朋友们 第一天在这里。

sentences.en: And he got up and he explained how he was driven to create some technology to help test for anemia, because people were dying unnecessarily.
sentences.zh: 他站起来解释他是如何 被驱使去创造一些技术 帮助测试贫血症, 因为人们正在不必要地死去。

sentences.en: And he said, "I saw this need. So you know what I did? I made it."
sentences.zh: 他说:“我看到了这个需要。你知道我做了什么吗?我做到了。”

sentences.en: And everybody just burst into applause, and they were like "Yes!"
sentences.zh: 大家欢呼声响起, 他们就像"是的!"

sentences.en: And he said, "And it didn't work. (Laughter) And then I made it 32 more times, and then it worked."
sentences.zh: 他说,“那没用的。(笑声) 然后我又做了32次,然后就成功了。”

sentences.en: You know what the big secret about TED is?
sentences.zh: 你知道TED的大秘密是什么吗?

sentences.en: I can't wait to tell people this. I guess I'm doing it right now.
sentences.zh: 我等不及要告诉别人了 我想我现在正在做

sentences.en: (Laughter) This is like the failure conference.
sentences.zh: 这就像失败的会议。

sentences.en: (Laughter) No, it is. (Applause) You know why this place is amazing?
sentences.zh: 不,它是。 你知道为什么这个地方是惊人的?

sentences.en: Because very few people here are afraid to fail.
sentences.zh: 因为这里很少有人害怕失败

sentences.en: And no one who gets on the stage, so far that I've seen, has not failed.
sentences.zh: 还没有人能上台, 至今为止,我所看到的, 还没有失败。

sentences.en: I've failed miserably, many times. I don't think the world understands that, because of shame.
sentences.zh: 我失败过很多次了 我不认为世界能理解,因为羞耻

sentences.en: There's a great quote that saved me this past year by Theodore Roosevelt.
sentences.zh: 西奥多·罗斯福去年救了我

sentences.en: A lot of people refer to it as the "Man in the Arena" quote.
sentences.zh: 很多人都把它叫做"竞技场里的人"

sentences.en: And it goes like this: "It is not the critic who counts.
sentences.zh: 事情是这样的:"不是批评者才是最重要的。

sentences.en: It is not the man who sits and points out how the doer of deeds could have done things better and how he falls and stumbles.
sentences.zh: 并不是坐着指出行为者如何能做得更好,以及他如何跌倒和跌倒的人。

sentences.en: The credit goes to the man in the arena whose face is marred with dust and blood and sweat.
sentences.zh: 功劳归于竞技场上 脸上沾满了灰尘、血和汗水的人

sentences.en: But when he's in the arena, at best, he wins, and at worst, he loses, but when he fails, when he loses, he does so daring greatly."
sentences.zh: 但当他进入竞技场时 最多他赢了 最坏他输了 但是当他失败了 当他输了 他胆大妄为

sentences.en: And that's what this conference, to me, is about.
sentences.zh: 对我来说,这就是会议的意义所在。

sentences.en: Life is about daring greatly, about being in the arena.
sentences.zh: 生活是大胆的, 关于在竞技场。

sentences.en: When you walk up to that arena and you put your hand on the door, and you think, "I'm going in and I'm going to try this," shame is the gremlin who says, "Uh, uh.
sentences.zh: 当你走到竞技场上 把手放在门上 你就会想"我要进去试试这个" 羞耻的是格伦林说"呃 呃"

sentences.en: You're not good enough. You never finished that MBA. Your wife left you.
sentences.zh: 你不够好 你从没完成过MBA 你妻子离开了你

sentences.en: I know your dad really wasn't in Luxembourg, he was in Sing Sing.
sentences.zh: 我知道你爸爸不是在卢森堡,他是在Sing Sing

sentences.en: I know those things that happened to you growing up.
sentences.zh: 我知道那些发生在你成长中的事情

sentences.en: I know you don't think that you're pretty, smart, talented or powerful enough.
sentences.zh: 我知道你不认为你漂亮,聪明,有才华 或足够强大。

sentences.en: I know your dad never paid attention, even when you made CFO."
sentences.zh: 我知道你爸爸从不留心 即使你做了CFO"

sentences.en: Shame is that thing. And if we can quiet it down and walk in and say, "I'm going to do this," we look up and the critic that we see pointing and laughing,
sentences.zh: 可惜的是,如果我们能安静下来,走进去说,“我要这么做。” 我们抬头看,我们看见的批评者指着笑,

sentences.en: 99 percent of the time is who? Us. Shame drives two big tapes -- "never good enough" -- and, if you can talk it out of that one,
sentences.zh: 99%的时间是谁?我们。羞耻驾驶两个大磁带—— “永远不够好”—— 如果你能把它说出去,

sentences.en: "who do you think you are?" The thing to understand about shame is, it's not guilt.
sentences.zh: "你以为你是谁?" 了解羞耻的是,这不是内疚。

sentences.en: Shame is a focus on self, guilt is a focus on behavior.
sentences.zh: 羞耻是自我的焦点 内疚是行为的重点

sentences.en: Shame is "I am bad." Guilt is "I did something bad."
sentences.zh: 羞耻是"我坏" 愧疚是"我做了坏事"

sentences.en: How many of you, if you did something that was hurtful to me, would be willing to say, "I'm sorry. I made a mistake?"
sentences.zh: 你们中有多少人,如果你们做了伤害我的事, 会愿意说,“对不起,我犯了错?”

sentences.en: How many of you would be willing to say that?
sentences.zh: 你们中有多少人愿意这么说?

sentences.en: Guilt: I'm sorry. I made a mistake. Shame: I'm sorry. I am a mistake.
sentences.zh: 内疚:对不起。我犯了一个错误。可惜:对不起。我犯了一个错误。

sentences.en: There's a huge difference between shame and guilt.
sentences.zh: 羞耻和内疚之间有很大的区别

sentences.en: And here's what you need to know. Shame is highly, highly correlated with addiction, depression, violence, aggression, bullying, suicide, eating disorders.
sentences.zh: 这就是你需要知道的。羞耻与吸毒、抑郁、暴力、侵犯、欺凌、自杀、饮食紊乱 有着高度的关联。

sentences.en: And here's what you even need to know more.
sentences.zh: 这就是你需要知道的

sentences.en: Guilt, inversely correlated with those things.
sentences.zh: 内疚,反之亦然

sentences.en: The ability to hold something we've done or failed to do up against who we want to be is incredibly adaptive.
sentences.zh: 握住我们做过或没做过的事情 对付我们想要成为谁的能力 是非常有适应性的。

sentences.en: It's uncomfortable, but it's adaptive. The other thing you need to know about shame is it's absolutely organized by gender.
sentences.zh: 这很不舒服,但它是适应性的。关于羞耻,你需要知道的另一件事是,它绝对是由性别组成的。

sentences.en: If shame washes over me and washes over Chris, it's going to feel the same.
sentences.zh: 如果羞耻冲着我 冲着克里斯 感觉会一样

sentences.en: Everyone sitting in here knows the warm wash of shame.
sentences.zh: 坐在这里的每个人都知道 羞耻的温暖冲洗。

sentences.en: We're pretty sure that the only people who don't experience shame are people who have no capacity for connection or empathy.
sentences.zh: 我们非常肯定 唯一没有羞耻感的人 是那些没有沟通或同情能力的人

sentences.en: Which means, yes, I have a little shame; no, I'm a sociopath.
sentences.zh: 也就是说,是的,我有点羞耻 不,我是反社会者

sentences.en: So I would opt for, yes, you have a little shame.
sentences.zh: 所以我会选择,是的,你有点羞耻。

sentences.en: Shame feels the same for men and women, but it's organized by gender.
sentences.zh: 男人和女人都感到羞耻 但都是由性别组成的

sentences.en: For women, the best example I can give you is Enjoli, the commercial.
sentences.zh: 对于妇女来说,我可以给你们最好的例子 就是Enjoli, 广告。

sentences.en: "I can put the wash on the line, pack the lunches, hand out the kisses and be at work at five to nine.
sentences.zh: "我可以把洗手在线路上, 打包午餐, 亲吻出来 和在工作5到9。

sentences.en: I can bring home the bacon, fry it up in the pan and never let you forget you're a man."
sentences.zh: 我可以把培根带回家 煎在锅里 永远不要忘记你是个男人"

sentences.en: For women, shame is, do it all, do it perfectly and never let them see you sweat.
sentences.zh: 对女人来说,羞耻是, 做这一切, 做得完美 而且不让他们看到你出汗。

sentences.en: I don't know how much perfume that commercial sold, but I guarantee you, it moved a lot of antidepressants and anti-anxiety meds.
sentences.zh: 我不知道那个广告卖了多少香水 但我向你保证 它能移动很多抗抑郁药和抗焦虑药

sentences.en: (Laughter) Shame, for women, is this web of unobtainable, conflicting, competing expectations about who we're supposed to be.
sentences.zh: 羞耻,对于妇女来说, 是这个网 无法实现, 冲突,竞争 期望我们是谁。

sentences.en: And it's a straight-jacket. For men, shame is not a bunch of competing, conflicting expectations.
sentences.zh: 对男人来说,羞耻不是一堆相互竞争和矛盾的期望。

sentences.en: Shame is one, do not be perceived as what?
sentences.zh: 羞耻是其中之一,不被视为什么?

sentences.en: Weak. I did not interview men for the first four years of my study.
sentences.zh: 软弱,我头四年没面试男人了

sentences.en: It wasn't until a man looked at me after a book signing, and said, "I love what say about shame, I'm curious why you didn't mention men."
sentences.zh: 直到一个男人在签了书之后看着我说, “我喜欢关于羞耻的话,我很好奇你为什么不提男人。”

sentences.en: And I said, "I don't study men." And he said, "That's convenient."
sentences.zh: 我说,"我不学习男人。" 他说,"这是方便的。"

sentences.en: (Laughter) And I said, "Why?" And he said, "Because you say to reach out, tell our story, be vulnerable.
sentences.zh: 我说,"为什么?" 他说,"因为你说 伸出手,告诉我们的故事, 脆弱。

sentences.en: But you see those books you just signed for my wife and my three daughters?"
sentences.zh: 但你看见你刚为我妻子和三个女儿 签的书了吗?"

sentences.en: I said, "Yeah." "They'd rather me die on top of my white horse than watch me fall down.
sentences.zh: 我说,"是的。" "他们宁愿我死在我的白马上面 而不是看我跌倒。

sentences.en: When we reach out and be vulnerable, we get the shit beat out of us.
sentences.zh: 当我们伸出援手 变得脆弱时 就会被打得屁滚尿流

sentences.en: And don't tell me it's from the guys and the coaches and the dads.
sentences.zh: 别告诉我是男教练和爸爸送的

sentences.en: Because the women in my life are harder on me than anyone else."
sentences.zh: "因为我生命中的女人比我任何人都难"

sentences.en: So I started interviewing men and asking questions.
sentences.zh: 于是我开始采访男人 问问题

sentences.en: And what I learned is this: You show me a woman who can actually sit with a man in real vulnerability and fear, I'll show you a woman who's done incredible work.
sentences.zh: 我学到了这个: 你给我看一个女人, 她能和一个真正处于脆弱和恐惧中的男人坐在一起, 我会给你们看一个做过不可思议工作的女人。

sentences.en: You show me a man who can sit with a woman who's just had it, she can't do it all anymore, and his first response is not, "I unloaded the dishwasher!"
sentences.zh: 你告诉我一个男人谁可以坐 与一个女人谁刚刚得到了它, 她不能做这一切了, 他的第一个回答是,"我卸下洗碗机!"

sentences.en: (Laughter) But he really listens -- because that's all we need -- I'll show you a guy who's done a lot of work.
sentences.zh: (笑声) 但他真的在听- 因为这是我们需要的- 我会给你们展示一个做了很多工作的人。

sentences.en: Shame is an epidemic in our culture. And to get out from underneath it -- to find our way back to each other, we have to understand how it affects us
sentences.zh: 羞耻是我们文化中的一种流行病。为了摆脱这种流行病 -- -- 找到我们回到彼此身边的方式,我们必须理解它对我们的影响。

sentences.en: and how it affects the way we're parenting, the way we're working, the way we're looking at each other.
sentences.zh: 和它如何影响我们做父母的方式, 我们的工作方式, 我们看对方的方式。

sentences.en: Very quickly, some research by Mahalik at Boston College.
sentences.zh: 很快 波士顿学院的Mahalik做了一些研究

sentences.en: He asked, what do women need to do to conform to female norms?
sentences.zh: 他问到,妇女需要做些什么才能符合女性规范?

sentences.en: The top answers in this country: nice, thin, modest and use all available resources for appearance.
sentences.zh: 这个国家最顶尖的答案是: 优雅、瘦弱、谦虚, 并且利用所有可用的资源来露面。

sentences.en: (Laughter) When he asked about men, what do men in this country need to do to conform with male norms, the answers were: always show emotional control, work is first,
sentences.zh: 当他问到男人, 在这个国家,男人需要做什么 符合男性规范, 答案是: 总是表现出情感控制, 工作是第一,

sentences.en: pursue status and violence. If we're going to find our way back to each other, we have to understand and know empathy, because empathy's the antidote to shame.
sentences.zh: 追求地位和暴力。如果我们要找到我们的方法 回到彼此, 我们必须理解和知道同情, 因为同情是解决羞耻的解药。

sentences.en: If you put shame in a Petri dish, it needs three things to grow exponentially: secrecy, silence and judgment.
sentences.zh: 如果你把羞耻放进Petri菜里, 它需要三样东西来成倍增长: 保密、沉默和判断。

sentences.en: If you put the same amount in a Petri dish and douse it with empathy, it can't survive.
sentences.zh: 如果你把同样的数量放进一个Petri盘子 并且用同情心用它, 它就活不下去。

sentences.en: The two most powerful words when we're in struggle: me too.
sentences.zh: 当我们在挣扎时 最强大的两个词: 我也是。

sentences.en: And so I'll leave you with this thought.
sentences.zh: 所以,我会离开你 与这个想法。

sentences.en: If we're going to find our way back to each other, vulnerability is going to be that path.
sentences.zh: 如果我们要找到回路 脆弱就是那条路

sentences.en: And I know it's seductive to stand outside the arena, because I think I did it my whole life, and think to myself, I'm going to go in there and kick some ass when I'm bulletproof and when I'm perfect.
sentences.zh: 我知道站在竞技场外面很诱人 因为我觉得我做了一辈子 对自己想 当我防弹和完美的时候 我会进去踢一些屁股

sentences.en: And that is seductive. But the truth is, that never happens.
sentences.zh: 这很诱人,但事实是,这永远不会发生

sentences.en: And even if you got as perfect as you could and as bulletproof as you could possibly muster when you got in there, that's not what we want to see.
sentences.zh: 即使你得到了尽可能完美 和尽可能的防弹 当你到达那里时,你可能聚集, 这不是我们想看到的。

sentences.en: We want you to go in. We want to be with you and across from you.
sentences.zh: 我们想让你进去 我们想和你在一起 和你对面

sentences.en: And we just want, for ourselves and the people we care about and the people we work with, to dare greatly.
sentences.zh: 我们只是想 为自己和我们关心的人 和我们合作的人 敢于冒险

sentences.en: So thank you all very much. I really appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你们,我真的很感激。

sentences.en: (Applause)
sentences.zh: （掌声）
